{{Quote|I am Mulus Cheems. I am a scientist specializing in crystalline materials&hellip;and a historian in the field of jewelry.|Mulus Cheems|<ref name="MK" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Mulus Cheems''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] mineral analyst who was held captive by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] on the world of [[Ryvester]]. Cheems was held by Teradoc to research methods of remotely disabling the gems in [[Jedi]] [[lightsaber]]s via a sonic device. Though his research revealed that the hilts were too insulated, he did not disclose that information to Teradoc, as that would have meant the end of his usefulness to the admiral. He was freed from Teradoc's grip in one of Ryvester's [[Unidentified club (Ryvester)|bars]] by [[Wraith Squadron]], who had lured the admiral out with a false, apparently-valueless artifact, which Cheems said was real even though he knew it wasn't. At the bar, Teradoc double-crossed Wraith Leader, [[Garik Loran]], who was posing as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] offering a valuable artifact in exchange for Teradoc's help in retrieving more from the [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes|Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]] hoard. In response, Loran called in the rest of the Wraiths and set off a small explosive containing an eye irritant. The Wraiths subdued Teradoc's men and cleared an escape route, bringing Cheems with them to a [[Teradoc's yacht|yacht]] of Teradoc's, which they stole.<ref name="MK" />

After Cheems was freed, the members of Wraith Squadron explained not only was their mission to save him, but also to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] Teradoc with the false artifact, which was really a series of explosives wired together, set to go off once it was secure in the admiral's [[Imperial Navy base (Ryvester)|base]]. The explosives were successful in destroying Teradoc, along with a vault full of bioweapons.<ref name="MK" />

Cheems later aided the reformed Wraiths [[Standard year|years]] later in [[44 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> by providing gems to decorate a [[Embass suit|disguise]] made for [[Clawdite]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Turman Durra]]. The Wraiths were planning a ruse to draw out traitorous [[General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] to [[Kuratooine]]. Cheems' adopted [[Yuuzhan Vong]] son, [[Viull Gorsat]], was part of the Wraiths at this time, and engineered the disguise for Durra so the actor could emulate a local sentient species that had woken up from a long hibernation and was ostensibly interested in a lucrative trade in valuable gem-encrusted 'art' with the general. Thaal was lured to Kuratooine by Durra's ploy and promise of gems and the Wraiths were able to collapse his numerous illicit enterprises. The ruse was successful and ultimately resulted in Thaal's exposure, disgrace, and capture.<ref name="MK" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|My father is a multidisciplinary scientist. Inorganic chemistry, mineralogy, gemology, physics.|Viull Gorsat|<ref name="MK" />}}
Mulus Cheems was a talented gemology expert whose skills led Teradoc to abduct him and force him to work for him. Cheems also invented several sonic devices for cutting gems, including the [[Cheems Sonic Chisel]].<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cheems was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth installment of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-wing novel series'']] in [[2012]].<ref name="MK" />
